_mode_legend.audit_only: OpenClaw can inspect and produce plans, but cannot mutate the DB.
_mode_legend.assisted: OpenClaw produces a completion plan and waits for human approval before execution.
_mode_legend.autonomous: OpenClaw can execute allowed work under strict budget and policy.

provider_notes.eastmoney_first: Eastmoney is the most stable channel as of 2026-06-02 (0.36 s/fund for NAV, ~95% success rate). Used as the default for nav_history and snapshots.
provider_notes.akshare_v1_18_64_drift: AkShare v1.18.64 has known schema drift on fund_portfolio_bond_hold_em (KeyError on 占净值比例) and fund_portfolio_industry_allocation_em (Length mismatch on reset_index). Stock holdings silently returns 0 rows. The auto chain falls through to Investoday for stock_holdings, but bond/industry have no downstream fallback yet — expect low success rate on those two until the Investoday bond/industry endpoints land.
provider_notes.tushare_role: If TUSHARE_TOKEN is set, Tushare covers AkShare-only capabilities at ~200 calls/min. Pair `--provider tushare` with the `auto` chain as a fallback.
provider_notes.investoday_role: Investoday (with INVESTODAY_API_KEY) is the long-term replacement for the broken AkShare paths. Currently supports stock_holdings + fund_profiles; bond/industry endpoints are pending.
